method: Business contributors to current officeholders (campaign.json), 2026 local candidates (../elections/finance_2026.json) and every other local campaign since 2016 (campaign_history.json) were compared with every payee on this site: contracts, change orders and emergency purchases (../contracts/contracts.json), Bay County and Lynn Haven check registers, payments by the three tourism agencies (../money/payments.json) and the CRA ledger (../merged.json). Both sides are resolved to vendor ids in ../entities/vendors.json: names are matched after removing punctuation, "&"/"and" and legal suffixes, plus hand-checked joins of truncated or misspelled names (each with its evidence in vendors.json). Nothing is fuzzy-matched. "exact" = the filed name matches the vendor's name; "likely" = the filing truncates, abbreviates or misspells it. One row per contributor spelling, candidate and paying government. A match shows only that an organization with the same name appears in both public records; it does not show why a gift was made or how a contract was awarded. Built by build_vendor_matches.py.
